description: Joining the room: who may join and in which meeting status; token issuing.
precondition: Meeting and participants seeded; LiveKit replaced by a recorder.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is an active current participant.
LiveKit is configured with TokenTtlMinutes 10.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant user; recordingNoticeAcknowledged: default false.
cases.return: Success with a join ticket: serverUrl from configuration, roomName "meeting-{id}", identity the bare user id, metadata {"meetingRole":"Member"}, expiry = now + 10 minutes. Nothing is written; the visit is recorded only when the provider reports the person actually in.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a verified guest session of this meeting with a declared display name.
LiveKit is configured.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: that guest session; recordingNoticeAcknowledged: true.
cases.return: Success with a join ticket whose identity is "guest-{sessionId}"; one audit row call.guest_admitted (object = the session, no actor, with meetingId, invitationId, display name, recordingNoticeAcknowledged true) written before any token exists.

preconditions: Caller cannot read the meeting (stranger, or meeting does not exist).
cases.inputs: meetingId: that meeting; caller: the stranger.
cases.return: NotFound; no ticket, nothing written, existence stays hidden.

preconditions: Caller holds a verified guest session of another meeting.
cases.inputs: meetingId: this meeting; caller: that guest session; recordingNoticeAcknowledged: true.
cases.return: NotFound; a guest token of another meeting is answered as if the meeting did not exist.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode InPerson; caller is a current participant.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant.
cases.return: InPersonMeeting; 409 "Cuộc họp này họp trực tiếp nên không có phòng họp trực tuyến." (MSG280); no ticket.

preconditions: Meeting Published with mode Online; caller is a current participant.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant.
cases.return: RoomNotOpen; 409 "Phòng họp chỉ mở khi cuộc họp đang diễn ra." (MSG117); no ticket.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a current participant.
LiveKit is not configured.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant.
cases.return: NotConfigured; 503 "Phòng họp trực tuyến chưa sẵn sàng. Vui lòng liên hệ quản trị viên." (MSG281); no ticket.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a verified guest session of this meeting.
LiveKit is configured.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: that guest session; recordingNoticeAcknowledged: false (the notice was not confirmed on the waiting screen).
cases.return: RecordingNoticeRequired; 400 "Vui lòng xác nhận đã đọc thông báo ghi âm trước khi vào phòng họp." (MSG380); no token and no audit row.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a verified guest session of this meeting.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: that guest session; recordingNoticeAcknowledged sent as the text "true" instead of JSON true.
cases.return: RecordingNoticeRequired (MSG380); only the JSON value true counts.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a current participant.
LiveKit is configured with TokenTtlMinutes 0.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant.
cases.return: Success with a ticket expiring in 1 minute; a zero or negative lifetime is clamped up to 1 minute.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a current participant.
LiveKit is configured with TokenTtlMinutes 120.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant.
cases.return: Success with a ticket expiring in 60 minutes; an over-long lifetime is clamped down to 60 minutes.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a current participant.
The access read fails in storage.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant.
cases.return: ReadFailed; 500 "Không thể vào phòng họp. Vui lòng thử lại." (MSG118); no ticket.
cases.log: Could not read call room access for meeting {MeetingId}.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a verified guest session of this meeting.
The guest-admission audit write fails in storage.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: that guest session; recordingNoticeAcknowledged: true.
cases.return: ReadFailed (MSG118); no token is issued without the recorded evidence of the notice.
cases.log: Could not record the admission of guest session {SessionId}.

preconditions: A caller that is neither a signed-in user nor a guest (no id on either side).
cases.return: No result; the member identity cannot be resolved.
cases.exception: ArgumentException: a caller is a user or a guest.
